policy.unit_of_observation: One row represents one metric from one benchmark split and one named system configuration. Never combine metrics from different configurations into a synthetic system.
policy.comparison_ceiling: All included external scores are contextual or historical references unless a separately preregistered matched comparison is recorded; no direct CEB superiority claim is supported by this registry.
policy.uncertainty_rule: Preserve source-reported uncertainty notation. Do not infer a confidence level or interval method unless the source states it.
policy.denominator_rule: Every task or pair count belongs to its exact benchmark/split. Missing denominators must be explicitly marked not_reported, not silently imputed.
policy.unlabeled_rule: An unlabeled leaderboard value remains unlabeled; it cannot be mapped to a named metric by guesswork.

caveats: 11 repositories.
Scale removed 89 invalid tasks and corrected 69 contradictory instructions.
Agent phase has no web tools; patches are pristine-regraded; reference-patch-pass and empty-patch-fail are required.
Scale still documents a trusted endpoint relay and verifier execution of candidate-controlled code as residual risks.
Separate 51-task denominator; never merge with Full.
Small split; retain task-level uncertainty.
11 repositories and four languages per benchmark description.
Runtime analysis and multi-file comprehension rubric differs from CEB source-claim adjudication.
66 repositories and eight languages.
Agent systems use ContextBench-specific adaptations.
Recall, Pass@1 and Context F1 maxima belong to different systems; preserve the exact row for each metric.
Test-writing rubric is not equivalent to mutation kill rate or oracle soundness.
10 repositories and six languages per benchmark description.
Score does not establish collateral-change ratio on CEB tasks.
Means over all tasks; ± values are reported 95% intervals (1.96 × standard error).
Edit precision uses epsilon-relaxed matching ε=2.
Multi-line and repository-level tasks; do not merge with PDB-Single Hard.
Means over all tasks; ± values are reported 95% intervals (1.96 × standard error).
Edit precision uses epsilon-relaxed matching ε=1.
98 open-source repositories.
An additional 800 proprietary tasks were collected; the cited 71.9% figure is the open-source result, not a score over 1,800 tasks.
Top-five bug detection is not precision.
108 open-source Python projects and 77 CWE classes.
34 agent/model configurations independently benchmarked.
Functional and secure results must remain attached to the same configuration.
34 Rust repositories.
Claude Sonnet 3.7 + RUSTFORGER is a historical model/harness baseline, not a November 2026 frontier comparison.
Nine repositories.
Expert-relative speedup requires matching hardware, workload, toolchain and correctness gates.
150 software-engineering and 150 text-to-SQL tasks; 200 public and 100 private held-out; 1,131 injected blockers.
ASK-F1 is Question Precision/Blocker Recall harmonic mean; Pass@3 is at least one success in three independent assisted runs.
The consolidated leaderboard value 79.67 ± 4.17 remains unlabeled; do not assign it ASK-F1 or Pass@3 semantics.
The best domain blocker-recall figures are stored separately for SWE and SQL; model identities are not reported in the overview.
Independent benchmark review, not an agent performance leaderboard.
Thirty publicly noted scoring defects were identified in 66 tasks.
Tamper-resistant verifiers are identified as a 4.1 focus, not an already-qualified released feature.
Use the source's rerun/regrade/reuse versioning distinctions as methodology only.
42 executable environments; eight abstention scenarios.
Primary metric is paired accuracy: both sides of the pair must be correct.
Act, Abstain and CAR are separate component metrics, macro-averaged over scenarios.
150 SWE tasks; 3–5 injected blockers per task; exact blocker count not separately stated.
Domain maximum blocker-recall result; system identity not stated in overview.
150 SQL tasks; 3–5 injected blockers per task; exact blocker count not separately stated.
Domain maximum blocker-recall result; system identity not stated in overview.
